entities.name: Civil Rights Act of 1964
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Landmark legislation that outlawed discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, or national origin. It ended unequal voter registration requirements, racial segregation in schools, workplaces, and public accommodations.
